rawContent: Wait...what about other officer? Younger cop told him he was fixing to get electric chair before anyone told him why they pulled him over?Will Gutierrez go work elsewhere? Traffic stops aren’t war. We need new system. Lt Nazario treated inhumanely.  #BLM #DefundPolice

Heartbreaking. He was shot with Mom on the phone & girlfriend in car. He fled outstanding warrant. Everyone should get to their trial alive. Cops shouldn’t be juries & executioners. The car crashed endangering lives. #BLM

Watching videos I realized when they asked him to get on the ground George Floyd must have been on his mind. Lt Navario so calm. His training & uniform likely kept him alive. Infuriating. #BLM Traffic stops shouldn’t be this way. We need meaningful reform George Floyd Act.
@Darryl_Forges @donlemon I cannot imagine being on the phone or in the car with him. Heartbroken for his Mom and girlfriend. The trauma...#SayHisName #DaunteWright #BLM
End the filibuster. We need the George Floyd act ASAP if country isn’t ready to RE imagine crisis response #BLM
